spans.s: 1. यौवत n. (fr. युवति) a number of girls or young women, Gīt. (Pāṇ. iv, 2, 38).
2. यौवत = यौतव, L.
the son of a young woman, Vop.
youth, youthfulness, adolescence, puberty, manhood (also pl. = juvenile deeds or indiscretions; ifc. f(आ). ), AV. &c. &c.
a number of young people (esp. of young women), Pāṇ. iv, 2, 38
N. of the third stage in the Śākta mysteries, Cat.
यौवन—कण्टक m. n. an eruption or pimples on the face (esp. of young people), L.
यौवन—दर्प m. juvenile pride or indiscretion, Hit.
यौवन—दशा f. the period of youth, ib.
यौवन—पदवी f. the path of youth (˚वीम् आरूढः, having entered on adolescence), Pañcat.
यौवन—पिडका f. = -कण्टक, Suśr.
यौवन—प्रान्त m. the extreme verge or end of youth, ib.
यौवन—भिन्न-शैशव mfn. whose childhood is separated off by youth, passing from childhood to manhood, MW.
यौवन—मत्ता f. ‘intoxicated with (the pride of) youth’, N. of a metre, Col.
यौवन—लक्षण n. ‘sign of youth’, the female breast, L.
loveliness, grace, L.
यौवन—वत् mfn. possessing youth, young, youthful, Vet.; Hit.; Kathās.
यौवन—श्री f. the beauty of youthfulness, Bhartṛ.
यौवन—सुख n. the joys of youth or of love, Mṛcch.
यौवन—स्थ mfn. being in the (bloom of) youth, arrived at puberty, marriageable, MBh.
ending in youth, having youthfulness at the end, Kum.
the prime of youth, first bloom of youth, juvenility, Mālatīm.
one who has arrived at adolescence or puberty, Kathās.
the state of youth, youthfulness, puberty, MW.
the ardour of youthful passion, L.
the god of love, L.
= यौवन, g. मनोज्ञादि.
patr. of Māndhātṛ, Pravar.; MBh. &c.
of a grandson of Māndhātṛ, BhP. (accord. to Pāṇ. vi, 2, 107, Sch., यौवन + अश्व).
patr. of Māndhātṛ, L.
id., MBh.; R.
and f(आ). = यौवन, youth, L.
youthful, Hariv.; MārkP.
youthful, juvenile (with द्वार् f. the gates of youth or adolescence), Naiṣ.
mf(आ, or ई)n. (fr. युव-राज), g. काश्य्-आदि.
(fr. युव-राज; ifc. f(आ). ) the rank or office or rights of an heir-apparent, the right of succession to a kingdom, MBh.; R. &c.
